subject: Re: Medexa RFP — request for bakeoff credits and timeline
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@medexahealth.com>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Medexa RFP — bakeoff credits request

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with Redwood's latency and cost controls. We're kicking off the RFP bakeoff next month and wanted to request a sandbox credit allocation to run side-by-side tests against our incumbent vendor.

Ask: 250k token-equivalent sandbox credits for a 3-week bakeoff (split across two feature teams). We need the credits available by Dec 6 for an initial load test.

Attached: Medexa_RFP_v2.pdf (overview + expected test plan).

Timeline: RFP closes Dec 15, results presentation Dec 20.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the credits and if there are any procurement/PO steps we should follow? Lori Chen (cc) is our procurement lead.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Director of AI Platforms
Medexa Health
From: mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@medexahealth.com>
Cc: Lori Chen <lori.chen@medexahealth.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Medexa RFP — bakeoff credits request

Hi Samir — great to hear, and congrats on getting the RFP timeline locked.

Short answer: we can support a sandbox top-up for the bakeoff, but need to align on the exact allocation, SLOs, and procurement. A few clarifying items:
- Confirmation: 250k token-equivalent across 3 weeks (is that total or per-team?).
- Traffic profile: steady inference vs heavy headroom for batch jobs (attach the Topup_Request_Form.xlsx back to me with the expected qps/seq len).
- Procurement: our normal flow is a PO + short MSA addendum for promotional credits; legal signs a one-off credit agreement.

I'll loop in Vanessa for funding approval and Karthik for any quota/throughput gating. If you can send the completed Topup_Request_Form (quick spreadsheet) we'll route internally. Do you have a PO template or should we issue a DocuSign?

Thanks — I can aim to confirm by EOD tomorrow pending internal approvals.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
To: mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Medexa RFP — bakeoff credits request

Forwarding Samir's request — quick read.

My take: 250k tokens is reasonable as a promotional top-up for a three-week bakeoff, but we should gate it on:
- Explicit usage window and auto-expiry after Dec 31 (no roll-over).
- A small success metric: presentation to Medexa engineering panel on Dec 20 (helps marketing).
- Reduce exposure: split 60% / 40% across the two teams and cap per-hour qps to avoid abuse.

Budget: I can approve up to 200k from the regional promotional pool; anything above needs Marcus sign-off (cc'd).

Also note: procurement prefers a PO. If Medexa wants a credit offset reflected on an invoice, we need the PO to match our credit schedule.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com, mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 12:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Medexa RFP — bakeoff credits request

Thanks for the context. Conditional approve subject to the following (I copied what I need for ops):
1) Split the 250k into 200k promotional credits + 50k on trial terms (invoice offset if they convert).
2) Credits auto-expire 2027-01-15. No roll-over.
3) Ops: set a per-tenant qps guardrail at 45 qps and prefix/KV caching turned on for common test prompts.

I've attached the Topup_Request_Form.xlsx (completed with the expected qps & seq length). Mateo — please send Samir the completed form and ask for either a PO or DocuSign confirmation from procurement. Marcus, please sign-off on the extra 50k promotional delta if you agree.

-Karthik
